profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Software Engineer specialized in distributed systems and performance at scale.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Spanner Infrastructure - Distributed Consensus (Paxos) and Transaction

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led and contributed the design and implementation of the metadata layer in Delta, shaping the core architecture of Databricks lakehouse platform. Delivered key strategic features, including Shallow Clone, Commit Service, and Catalog-Managed Commit, which enabled multi-statement transactions – a critical infrastructure change. This feature was highlighted in the Delta 4.0 preview and 2025 DATA+AI summit.
- Owner of the Commit Service, a tier 0 control-plane service responsible for coordinating writes to the object store across multiple clusters for Delta. Led initiatives for latency optimization and caching improvements, ensuring the service’s robust performance at scale. Managed a 15X+ traffic growth at Databricks over the past 4 years.
- Developed an internal performance profiling tool, now one of the companys most-utilized tooling for optimizing query performance across various engineering teams.
- Mentored and trained engineers on key architecture and performance optimization, enabling them to independently handle high-priority deliverables and contributing to their successful promotions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech lead that co-leads 15 persons team to build a in-house cloud scale distributed file system purposely built for Rubrik's data management platform. Highly available, auto-scale, erasure coding, masterless, hybrid use of different storage device (disk, flash, cloud storage like S3).

Go-to person for a company wide performance issue. Resolved enterprise level critical performance issues and POCs. Served as a performance area's tech lead in Rubrik's data platform engineering group.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech lead for a cloud scale distributed file system team. 
Specialized in "Performance", usually affects market competition directly. Constantly served as a go-to person for the performance issues.

One of the most recent project that I worked was introduced as a "first bullet item" in our product release 5.2 Rubrik Andes highlight marked as "Blazingly Fast VMware Performance".
I received Rubrik’s first engineering excellence award for this.

My main focuses are:
- Led the team building scalable and robust file systems with market leading performance.
- Improved core system performance that directly connects to core products.
- Changed the team's paradigm to own dev testing and care performance benchmark, hence always data/metrics driven movement on any performance improvement

Also, I deeply influenced in the following area:
- Telemetry architecture (for performance metrics)
- Numerous performance issues in cross boundary area
- Collaborated with all teams to improve their system/product performance

positions.title: Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Tech lead for a cloud scale distributed file system team.

Built a couple of core modules for the distributed file systems from the scratch. Created a novel IO scheduler that manages diverse workloads in customer's on-prem systems. Patented. This enabled Rubrik to restore the customer data much faster even in very busy systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern (Ph.D.)
positions.description: Contributed the very early stage of VMware internal incubating product. Built the first version of the distributed file system project; later this product was released as a "vSAN Distributed File System" in VMware. Impacted beyond what intern was expected and nominated as a core hire list after internship.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
NVIUS was founded by core Lineage 2 developer team (Lineage 2 is the original work of Lineage Franchise which is $4B revenue making game software.)

Implemented core server modules that are heavily performance optimized, accepting millions of packets request per second for each machine. Used novel techniques to handle most of objects without taking locks. C++/Network/Windows Performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Semi tech lead for an online game server project that was published more than 20 countries.

Worked and improved most of core modules, including architect server topology, database interaction, load balance, locking, AI, log system, transaction, authorization.
